page.title: QA Challenges
page.subtitle: Complete test cases to earn badges and level up your QA automation skills

j-01.title: Login with valid credentials
j-01.description: Open the login page, enter a valid email and password, submit the form. Verify you are redirected to the home page and the user menu appears.
j-01.hint: Use the pre-seeded user: user@planq.dev / password123

j-02.title: Login with invalid credentials
j-02.description: Attempt to log in with a wrong password. Verify an error message is displayed and you remain on the login page.

j-03.title: Register a new user
j-03.description: Fill out the registration form with a unique email, name, and password. Submit and verify the account is created successfully.

j-04.title: Switch language EN to RU
j-04.description: Click the language toggle in the navbar. Verify that the UI text changes to Russian (e.g., 'Catalog' becomes 'Каталог').

j-05.title: Toggle dark/light theme
j-05.description: Click the theme toggle button. Verify the page switches between dark and light mode by checking the background color or the 'dark' class on <html>.
j-05.hint: The toggle may be behind a feature flag. Check data-testid='theme-toggle'.

j-06.title: Search for a product by name
j-06.description: Use the search bar (Ctrl+K) to search for a product. Verify the search results dropdown shows matching products.

j-07.title: Filter products by category
j-07.description: On the catalog page, click a category pill. Verify the product list updates to show only products from that category.

j-08.title: Sort products by price ascending
j-08.description: On the catalog page, select 'Price: Low to High' sort option. Verify the products are reordered with the cheapest first.

j-09.title: Add product to cart
j-09.description: Click 'Add to Cart' on any product. Verify the cart badge counter in the navbar increments.
j-09.hint: Check data-testid='cart-badge' for the counter value.

j-10.title: Remove product from cart
j-10.description: Navigate to the cart page, remove an item. Verify the item disappears and totals update.

j-11.title: Add product to wishlist
j-11.description: Click the heart icon on a product card to add it to your wishlist. Navigate to /wishlist and verify the product appears.

j-12.title: Navigate breadcrumbs
j-12.description: Open a product detail page. Verify breadcrumbs show 'Home > Catalog > Product Name'. Click 'Catalog' and verify navigation.

j-13.title: Open and close a modal
j-13.description: Trigger a modal (e.g., Quick View on a product card). Verify it opens with product details. Close it via the X button or clicking outside.

j-14.title: Verify product card content
j-14.description: On the catalog page, verify each product card displays: product name, price, rating stars, and an image.

j-15.title: Verify empty wishlist state
j-15.description: Navigate to /wishlist with no saved items. Verify the empty state message is displayed.

j-16.title: GET /health returns 200
j-16.description: Send a GET request to /api/health. Verify the response status is 200 and the body contains a status field.

j-17.title: GET /products returns paginated list
j-17.description: Send GET /api/products. Verify the response contains 'items' array and pagination metadata (total, page, limit).

j-18.title: GET /products/:id returns product details
j-18.description: Send GET /api/products/{id} with a valid product ID. Verify the response includes name, price, description, and images.

j-19.title: GET /categories returns array
j-19.description: Send GET /api/categories. Verify the response is an array of category objects with id, name, and slug fields.

j-20.title: POST /auth/login with valid credentials
j-20.description: Send POST /api/auth/login with valid email and password. Verify the response contains accessToken and refreshToken.

j-21.title: POST /auth/login with wrong password
j-21.description: Send POST /api/auth/login with a wrong password. Verify the response status is 401 and contains an error message.

j-22.title: GET /profile without token returns 401
j-22.description: Send GET /api/profile without an Authorization header. Verify the response status is 401 Unauthorized.

j-23.title: GET /products with search query
j-23.description: Send GET /api/products?search=sofa. Verify the returned items contain products matching the search term.

j-24.title: POST /cart without auth returns 401
j-24.description: Send POST /api/cart without an Authorization header. Verify the response status is 401.

j-25.title: GET /api-docs loads Swagger
j-25.description: Send GET /api/api-docs or open it in a browser. Verify the Swagger UI loads and shows available endpoints.

m-01.title: Complete full checkout flow
m-01.description: Add a product to cart, proceed to checkout, fill in shipping and payment details, place the order. Verify order confirmation page appears.

m-02.title: Apply promo code in cart
m-02.description: Add items to cart, enter promo code SAVE10, apply it. Verify the discount is reflected in the total price.
m-02.hint: The promo code field is on the cart page.

m-03.title: Use price range filter
m-03.description: On the catalog page, set a min and max price filter. Verify only products within that price range are displayed.

m-04.title: Test star rating filter
m-04.description: On the catalog page, click 3 stars in the rating filter. Verify only products with 3+ star ratings are shown.

m-05.title: Verify active filter chips
m-05.description: Apply multiple filters on the catalog page. Verify filter chips appear above the product list. Click X on a chip to remove it and verify the filter is removed.

m-06.title: Upload avatar in profile
m-06.description: Navigate to profile settings, upload a new avatar image. Verify the avatar preview updates and persists after page reload.

m-07.title: Change notification preferences
m-07.description: In profile settings, toggle notification preferences (email, push). Save changes and verify they persist after page reload.

m-08.title: Verify unsaved changes warning
m-08.description: Edit profile information but don't save. Try to navigate away. Verify a warning dialog appears about unsaved changes.

m-09.title: Verify card validation errors
m-09.description: In checkout, try submitting with: empty card number, past expiry date, Cyrillic cardholder name. Verify each shows appropriate validation errors.

m-10.title: Test grid/list view toggle
m-10.description: On the catalog page, toggle between grid and list view. Verify the layout changes and product information is still complete.

m-11.title: POST /auth/register verify emailVerified
m-11.description: Send POST /api/auth/register with new user data. Verify the response includes emailVerified: false.

m-12.title: Successful checkout via API
m-12.description: Send POST /api/orders/checkout with test card 4242424242424242. Verify the response status is success and order object is returned.
m-12.hint: You need a valid auth token and items in the cart first.

m-13.title: Declined card checkout via API
m-13.description: Send POST /api/orders/checkout with card 4000000000000002. Verify the response indicates payment was declined.

m-14.title: Filter products by specs via API
m-14.description: Send GET /api/products?material=wood&color=natural. Verify the returned products match the specified material and color.

m-15.title: PUT /addresses/:id update address
m-15.description: Send PUT /api/addresses/{id} with updated address fields. Verify the response contains the updated address.

m-16.title: DELETE /cards/:id remove saved card
m-16.description: Send DELETE /api/cards/{id} to remove a saved payment card. Verify 200 response and the card no longer appears in GET /cards.

m-17.title: GET /admin/stats as USER returns 403
m-17.description: Authenticate as a regular USER, then send GET /api/admin/stats. Verify the response status is 403 Forbidden.

m-18.title: GET /admin/users as MANAGER returns 403
m-18.description: Authenticate as a MANAGER role, then send GET /api/admin/users. Verify the response status is 403 Forbidden.
m-18.hint: Manager can access some admin routes but not user management.

m-19.title: Full registration to order E2E flow
m-19.description: Register a new user, verify email, log in, add a product to cart, complete checkout, view the order in order history. Verify the entire flow end-to-end.

m-20.title: Compare products feature
m-20.description: Add 3 products to the comparison list. Navigate to /compare and verify the comparison table shows all 3 products with their attributes side by side.

m-21.title: Cancel order and verify refund
m-21.description: Place an order, then cancel it. Verify the order status changes to 'Cancelled' and the wallet balance is credited with the refund amount.

m-22.title: Forgot password flow
m-22.description: Navigate to forgot password page, enter a valid email, submit. Verify success message. Try with an invalid email and verify the error.

m-23.title: Admin login redirects to /admin
m-23.description: Log in with admin credentials. Verify you are redirected to /admin dashboard and the store navigation links are not shown.

m-24.title: Cookie consent accept/decline
m-24.description: Visit the site in a fresh session. Verify the cookie consent banner appears. Click Accept and verify the banner disappears. Test Decline as well.
m-24.hint: Clear localStorage to see the banner again.

m-25.title: Keyboard shortcut Ctrl+K focuses search
m-25.description: Press Ctrl+K (or Cmd+K on Mac) anywhere on the site. Verify the search input opens and receives focus.

s-01.title: Complete CAPTCHA mock challenge
s-01.description: Trigger the CAPTCHA mock on the login page (after failed attempts). Complete the image grid challenge. Verify you can proceed with login after solving it.

s-02.title: Enable and use 2FA
s-02.description: In profile settings, enable two-factor authentication. Log out and log back in. Verify you are prompted for a 2FA code and can log in with it.

s-03.title: Verify notification scheduler via WebSocket
s-03.description: Enable scheduled notifications in admin settings. Subscribe to WebSocket events. Wait for the scheduled event and verify you receive the notification.
s-03.hint: The scheduler interval can be configured in admin settings.

s-04.title: Drag-and-drop reorder in cart
s-04.description: Add multiple items to cart. Drag and drop items to reorder them. Verify the new order persists after page refresh.

s-05.title: Verify countdown timer on sale products
s-05.description: Find a product with an active sale countdown. Verify the timer ticks down every second. Wait for at least 10 seconds and confirm the displayed time decreased.

s-06.title: Test session expired modal
s-06.description: Log in, then wait for the access token to expire (or manually clear it). Perform an action that requires auth. Verify the 'Session Expired' modal appears.
s-06.hint: You can speed this up by modifying the token expiry in dev tools.

s-07.title: Verify social login modals
s-07.description: On the login page, click each social login button (Google, GitHub, etc.). Verify each opens a modal or popup with the correct provider content.

s-08.title: Auto-progress order status via API
s-08.description: Create an order, then POST /api/test/orders/{id}/auto-progress. Subscribe to WebSocket and verify you receive status change events for each transition (processing → shipped → delivered).

s-09.title: Content negotiation with XML
s-09.description: Send GET /api/products with Accept: application/xml header. Verify the response content type and format differs from the default JSON response.

s-10.title: Scoped test data reset
s-10.description: Send POST /api/test/reset with a body specifying scope: 'orders'. Verify only orders are reset while products and users remain intact.

s-11.title: Generate test data via API
s-11.description: Send POST /api/test/generate with parameters for the type and quantity of data to create. Verify the specified test data is generated in the database.

s-12.title: Rate limiting on forgot-password
s-12.description: Send 11 consecutive POST requests to /api/auth/forgot-password with the same email. Verify the 11th request returns 429 Too Many Requests.
s-12.hint: Send requests rapidly without delays between them.

s-13.title: Verify admin audit log
s-13.description: Perform admin actions (edit product, change user role). Then GET /api/admin/audit. Verify the audit log contains entries for each action.

s-14.title: Toggle feature flag via API
s-14.description: Send PUT /api/admin/feature-flags/{key} to toggle a feature flag. Verify the flag state changes and the corresponding UI feature is affected.

s-15.title: Webhook subscription and delivery
s-15.description: Create a webhook subscription via the API. Trigger the subscribed event. Verify the webhook delivery log shows the event was sent.

s-16.title: Full order lifecycle E2E
s-16.description: Place an order, trigger auto-progress, and verify the tracking timeline UI updates in real-time for each status change (processing, shipped, delivered).

s-17.title: A/B variant with feature flag
s-17.description: Enable a feature flag that controls an A/B test variant (e.g., hero banner). Verify the UI changes to show the alternative variant.
s-17.hint: Use the admin panel to toggle the feature flag.

s-18.title: Flaky elements zone — delayed button
s-18.description: Find the flaky elements testing zone. Locate the button that appears after a random delay. Write a test that reliably waits for it and clicks it.
s-18.hint: Use explicit waits, not fixed sleep.

s-19.title: Multi-role authorization test
s-19.description: Log in as a regular USER and attempt to access admin API endpoints (verify 403). Then log in as ADMIN and access the same endpoints (verify 200).

s-20.title: WebSocket reconnection test
s-20.description: Establish a WebSocket connection, then force a disconnect (e.g., disable network briefly). Verify the client automatically reconnects and resumes receiving events.
